mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname, r.score, r.user_id AS userId, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.score DESC, r.submit_time ASC) AS rankNo FROM exam_record r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.paper_id = #{paperId} AND r.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'TIMEOUT') ORDER BY r.score DESC, r.submit_time ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.id AS paperId, p.title, p.total_score AS totalScore, p.pass_score AS passScore, COUNT(r.id) AS attendCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.score), 0) AS scoreSum, COALESCE(MAX(r.score), 0) AS maxScore, COALESCE(MIN(r.score), 0) AS minScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= p.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount FROM paper p LEFT JOIN exam_record r ON r.paper_id = p.id AND r.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'TIMEOUT') AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.total_score, p.pass_score ORDER BY p.id DESC
